body.condition: There are constants \(0<c_g<C_g<\infty\), locally uniform when \((a,b,c)\) ranges over compact exponent sets, such that \(c_g n^b\le g\le C_g n^b\).

novel.justification: Exponent-indexed cohort growth represents policy panels ranging from a sparse but expanding treated group to a fixed treated fraction, including subgroup analyses of the SEC Tick Size Pilot.
